title: Psalms 133
paragraphs: ¹ How good and pleasant it is when brothers and sisters live together in unity! ² It is like precious oil poured on the head, running down the beard, running down Aaron's beard, down onto the collar of his robe; ³ it is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD bestows his blessing, life forevermore.
